import Mathlib

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]

  -- !benchmark @start precond
  haystack.size < 1000000 ∧
  patterns.size > 0 ∧
  patterns.size < 1000000 ∧

    p.size < 1000000)

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
namespace ACA

/-- A word: the label of a trie node, i.e. a list of bytes. -/
abbrev W := List UInt8

/-! ### Specification layer: the set of trie nodes and longest suffix in it -/

/-- `isPrefB ps w` : `w` is a node of the trie built from `ps` (the empty word, i.e. the root,
is always a node). -/
def isPrefB (ps : List W) (w : W) : Bool :=
  w.isEmpty || ps.any (fun p => w.isPrefixOf p)

/-- Longest suffix of `w` satisfying `f`. -/
def lspf (f : W → Bool) : W → W
  | [] => []
  | a :: t => if f (a :: t) = true then a :: t else lspf f t

lemma lspf_nil (f : W → Bool) : lspf f [] = [] := by simp [lspf]

lemma lspf_cons_pos (f : W → Bool) (a : UInt8) (t : W) (h : f (a :: t) = true) :
    lspf f (a :: t) = a :: t := by simp [lspf, h]

lemma lspf_cons_neg (f : W → Bool) (a : UInt8) (t : W) (h : ¬ (f (a :: t) = true)) :
    lspf f (a :: t) = lspf f t := by simp [lspf, h]

lemma lspf_length_le (f : W → Bool) (w : W) : (lspf f w).length ≤ w.length := by
  induction w with
  | nil => simp [lspf]
  | cons a t ih =>
    by_cases h : f (a :: t) = true
    · rw [lspf_cons_pos f a t h]
    · rw [lspf_cons_neg f a t h]; simp; omega

lemma lspf_suffix (f : W → Bool) (w : W) : lspf f w <:+ w := by
  induction w with
  | nil => simp [lspf]
  | cons a t ih =>
    by_cases h : f (a :: t) = true
    · rw [lspf_cons_pos f a t h]
    · rw [lspf_cons_neg f a t h]
      exact ih.trans (List.suffix_cons a t)

lemma lspf_spec (f : W → Bool) (h0 : f [] = true) (w : W) : f (lspf f w) = true := by
  induction w with
  | nil => simpa [lspf] using h0
  | cons a t ih =>
    by_cases h : f (a :: t) = true
    · rw [lspf_cons_pos f a t h]; exact h
    · rw [lspf_cons_neg f a t h]; exact ih

/-- The failure chain of `s`: `s`, `fail s`, `fail (fail s)`, ..., root. -/
def chainSpec (f : W → Bool) : W → List W
  | [] => [[]]
  | a :: t => (a :: t) :: chainSpec f (lspf f t)
termination_by w => w.length
decreasing_by
  have h := lspf_length_le f t
  simp only [List.length_cons]
  omega

/-! ### Executable layer: trie, children, outputs -/

def insTrie (t : Std.HashSet W) (p : W) : Std.HashSet W :=
  ((List.range (p.length + 1)).map (fun k => p.take k)).foldl (fun t x => t.insert x) t

def buildTrie (ps : List W) : Std.HashSet W :=
  (ps.foldl insTrie (∅ : Std.HashSet W)).insert []

def insKids (m : Std.HashMap W (List UInt8)) (p : W) : Std.HashMap W (List UInt8) :=
  ((List.range p.length).map (fun k => (p.take k, p.getD k 0))).foldl
    (fun m q => m.insert q.1 (q.2 :: m.getD q.1 [])) m

def buildKids (ps : List W) : Std.HashMap W (List UInt8) :=
  ps.foldl insKids (∅ : Std.HashMap W (List UInt8))

def buildOuts (ps : List W) : Std.HashMap W (List Nat) :=
  ps.zipIdx.foldl (fun m q => m.insert q.1 (q.2 :: m.getD q.1 []))
    (∅ : Std.HashMap W (List Nat))

/-! ### Executable layer: automaton transition, failure chain, BFS -/

/-- `goto (s, c)` : follow failure links until the character `c` can be consumed. -/
def stepGo (trie : Std.HashSet W) (m : Std.HashMap W W) : Nat → W → UInt8 → W
  | 0, _, _ => []
  | _ + 1, [], c => if trie.contains [c] = true then [c] else []
  | fuel + 1, a :: t, c =>
      if trie.contains (a :: (t ++ [c])) = true then a :: (t ++ [c])
      else stepGo trie m fuel (m.getD (a :: t) []) c

def chainFuel (m : Std.HashMap W W) : Nat → W → List W
  | 0, _ => []
  | _ + 1, [] => [[]]
  | fuel + 1, a :: t => (a :: t) :: chainFuel m fuel (m.getD (a :: t) [])

/-- Failure link of the child `v ++ [c]` of the node `v`. -/
def failOf (trie : Std.HashSet W) (m : Std.HashMap W W) (v : W) (c : UInt8) : W :=
  match v with
  | [] => []
  | a :: t => stepGo trie m ((a :: t).length + 1) (m.getD (a :: t) []) c

/-- All (node, child character) pairs of the current BFS level. -/
def bfsPairs (kids : Std.HashMap W (List UInt8)) (level : List W) : List (W × UInt8) :=
  level.flatMap (fun v => (kids.getD v []).map (fun c => (v, c)))

/-- Set the failure links of all children of the current BFS level. -/
def bfsFold (trie : Std.HashSet W) (m : Std.HashMap W W) (pairs : List (W × UInt8)) :
    Std.HashMap W W :=
  pairs.foldl (fun m q => m.insert (q.1 ++ [q.2]) (failOf trie m q.1 q.2)) m

def bfsGo (trie : Std.HashSet W) (kids : Std.HashMap W (List UInt8)) :
    Nat → Std.HashMap W W → List W → Std.HashMap W W
  | 0, m, _ => m
  | _ + 1, m, [] => m
  | fuel + 1, m, v :: level =>
      bfsGo trie kids fuel (bfsFold trie m (bfsPairs kids (v :: level)))
        ((bfsPairs kids (v :: level)).map (fun q => q.1 ++ [q.2]))

def buildFail (trie : Std.HashSet W) (kids : Std.HashMap W (List UInt8)) (fuel : Nat) :
    Std.HashMap W W :=
  bfsGo trie kids fuel ((∅ : Std.HashMap W W).insert [] []) [[]]

/-! ### Executable layer: the text scan -/

def reportAt (m : Std.HashMap W W) (outs : Std.HashMap W (List Nat)) (s : W) (e : Nat) :
    List (Nat × Nat) :=
  (chainFuel m (s.length + 1) s).flatMap
    (fun u => (outs.getD u []).map (fun pid => (pid, e - u.length)))

def scan (trie : Std.HashSet W) (m : Std.HashMap W W) (outs : Std.HashMap W (List Nat)) :
    W → List UInt8 → Nat → List (Nat × Nat)
  | s, [], e => reportAt m outs s e
  | s, c :: cs, e =>
      reportAt m outs s e ++ scan trie m outs (stepGo trie m (s.length + 1) s c) cs (e + 1)

def acSearchOn (ps : List W) (text : List UInt8) : List (Nat × Nat) :=
  scan (buildTrie ps) (buildFail (buildTrie ps) (buildKids ps) ((ps.map List.length).sum + 1))
    (buildOuts ps) [] text 0

def acSearch (haystack : Array UInt8) (patterns : Array (Array UInt8)) : Array (Nat × Nat) :=
  (acSearchOn (patterns.toList.map Array.toList) haystack.toList).toArray

/-! ## Section A : properties of `lspf` and `chainSpec` -/

lemma isPrefB_nil (ps : List W) : isPrefB ps [] = true := by simp [isPrefB]

lemma isPrefB_of_mem (ps : List W) {u : W} (h : u ∈ ps) : isPrefB ps u = true := by
  simp only [isPrefB, Bool.or_eq_true, List.any_eq_true]
  exact Or.inr ⟨u, h, List.isPrefixOf_iff_prefix.mpr (List.prefix_refl u)⟩

lemma isPrefB_mono (ps : List W) {u w : W} (h : u <+: w) (hw : isPrefB ps w = true) :
    isPrefB ps u = true := by
  simp only [isPrefB, Bool.or_eq_true, List.isEmpty_iff, List.any_eq_true] at hw ⊢
  rcases hw with hw | ⟨p, hp, hpp⟩
  · left
    rw [hw] at h
    exact List.prefix_nil.mp h
  · right
    exact ⟨p, hp, List.isPrefixOf_iff_prefix.mpr
      (h.trans (List.isPrefixOf_iff_prefix.mp hpp))⟩

lemma isPrefB_append_iff (ps : List W) (v : W) (c : UInt8) :
    isPrefB ps (v ++ [c]) = true ↔ ∃ p ∈ ps, v ++ [c] <+: p := by
  simp only [isPrefB, Bool.or_eq_true, List.isEmpty_iff, List.any_eq_true]
  constructor
  · rintro (h | ⟨p, hp, hpp⟩)
    · exact absurd h (by simp)
    · exact ⟨p, hp, List.isPrefixOf_iff_prefix.mp hpp⟩
  · rintro ⟨p, hp, hpp⟩
    exact Or.inr ⟨p, hp, List.isPrefixOf_iff_prefix.mpr hpp⟩

lemma isPrefB_le_length (ps : List W) {y : W} (h : isPrefB ps y = true) :
    y = [] ∨ ∃ p ∈ ps, y.length ≤ p.length := by
  simp only [isPrefB, Bool.or_eq_true, List.isEmpty_iff, List.any_eq_true] at h
  rcases h with h | ⟨p, hp, hpp⟩
  · exact Or.inl h
  · exact Or.inr ⟨p, hp, (List.isPrefixOf_iff_prefix.mp hpp).length_le⟩

/-- The central lemma: the longest suffix in the trie of `x ++ [c]` only depends on the
longest suffix in the trie of `x`. -/
lemma lspf_append_step (f : W → Bool)
    (hcl : ∀ u w : W, u <+: w → f w = true → f u = true) (x : W) (c : UInt8) :
    lspf f (x ++ [c]) = lspf f (lspf f x ++ [c]) := by
  induction x with
  | nil => simp [lspf]
  | cons a t ih =>
    by_cases h : f (a :: t) = true
    · rw [lspf_cons_pos f a t h]
    · have h2 : ¬ (f (a :: (t ++ [c])) = true) := by
        intro hcon
        exact h (hcl (a :: t) (a :: (t ++ [c])) (by simp) hcon)
      have h3 : lspf f ((a :: t) ++ [c]) = lspf f (t ++ [c]) := by
        show lspf f (a :: (t ++ [c])) = _
        exact lspf_cons_neg f a (t ++ [c]) h2
      rw [h3, ih, lspf_cons_neg f a t h]

lemma suffix_lspf (f : W → Bool) {u : W} (hu : f u = true) :
    ∀ w : W, u <:+ w → u <:+ lspf f w := by
  intro w
  induction w with
  | nil => intro h; simpa [lspf] using h
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro h
    by_cases hf : f (a :: t) = true
    · rw [lspf_cons_pos f a t hf]; exact h
    · rw [lspf_cons_neg f a t hf]
      rcases List.suffix_cons_iff.mp h with heq | hs
      · exact absurd (heq ▸ hu) hf
      · exact ih hs

lemma mem_chainSpec_aux (f : W → Bool) (h0 : f [] = true) :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (w : W), w.length ≤ n → f w = true →
      ∀ u : W, (u ∈ chainSpec f w ↔ (u <:+ w ∧ f u = true)) := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro w hw _ u
    have hw0 : w = [] := List.eq_nil_of_length_eq_zero (by omega)
    subst hw0
    simp only [chainSpec, List.mem_singleton, List.suffix_nil]
    constructor
    · rintro rfl; exact ⟨rfl, h0⟩
    · rintro ⟨rfl, -⟩; rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    intro w hw hf u
    match w with
    | [] =>
      simp only [chainSpec, List.mem_singleton, List.suffix_nil]
      constructor
      · rintro rfl; exact ⟨rfl, h0⟩
      · rintro ⟨rfl, -⟩; rfl
    | a :: t =>
      have hlt : (lspf f t).length ≤ n := by
        have := lspf_length_le f t
        simp only [List.length_cons] at hw
        omega
      have hft : f (lspf f t) = true := lspf_spec f h0 t
      have hrec := ih (lspf f t) hlt hft u
      rw [show chainSpec f (a :: t) = (a :: t) :: chainSpec f (lspf f t) from by
        rw [chainSpec]]
      simp only [List.mem_cons, hrec]
      constructor
      · rintro (rfl | ⟨hsuf, hfu⟩)
        · exact ⟨List.suffix_rfl, hf⟩
        · exact ⟨hsuf.trans ((lspf_suffix f t).trans (List.suffix_cons a t)), hfu⟩
      · rintro ⟨hsuf, hfu⟩
        rcases List.suffix_cons_iff.mp hsuf with heq | hs
        · exact Or.inl heq
        · exact Or.inr ⟨suffix_lspf f hfu t hs, hfu⟩

lemma mem_chainSpec (f : W → Bool) (h0 : f [] = true) (w : W) (hf : f w = true) (u : W) :
    u ∈ chainSpec f w ↔ (u <:+ w ∧ f u = true) :=
  mem_chainSpec_aux f h0 w.length w le_rfl hf u

/-! ## Section B : correctness of the constructed tables -/

lemma contains_foldl_insert (l : List W) (t : Std.HashSet W) (w : W) :
    (l.foldl (fun t x => t.insert x) t).contains w = true ↔ (w ∈ l ∨ t.contains w = true) := by
  induction l generalizing t with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a l ih =>
    simp only [List.foldl_cons, ih, Std.HashSet.contains_insert, Bool.or_eq_true,
      beq_iff_eq, List.mem_cons]
    tauto

lemma mem_range_map_take (p w : W) :
    w ∈ (List.range (p.length + 1)).map (fun k => p.take k) ↔ w <+: p := by
  simp only [List.mem_map, List.mem_range]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨k, _, rfl⟩
    exact List.take_prefix k p
  · intro h
    refine ⟨w.length, by have := h.length_le; omega, ?_⟩
    exact ((List.prefix_iff_eq_take).mp h).symm

lemma contains_insTrie (t : Std.HashSet W) (p w : W) :
    (insTrie t p).contains w = true ↔ (w <+: p ∨ t.contains w = true) := by
  rw [insTrie, contains_foldl_insert, mem_range_map_take]

lemma contains_foldl_insTrie (ps : List W) (t : Std.HashSet W) (w : W) :
    (ps.foldl insTrie t).contains w = true ↔ ((∃ p ∈ ps, w <+: p) ∨ t.contains w = true) := by
  induction ps generalizing t with
  | nil => simp
  | cons p ps ih =>
    simp only [List.foldl_cons, ih, contains_insTrie, List.mem_cons]
    constructor
    · rintro (⟨q, hq, hw⟩ | hw | hw)
      · exact Or.inl ⟨q, Or.inr hq, hw⟩
      · exact Or.inl ⟨p, Or.inl rfl, hw⟩
      · exact Or.inr hw
    · rintro (⟨q, (rfl | hq), hw⟩ | hw)
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inl hw)
      · exact Or.inl ⟨q, hq, hw⟩
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inr hw)

lemma contains_buildTrie (ps : List W) (w : W) :
    (buildTrie ps).contains w = isPrefB ps w := by
  rw [Bool.eq_iff_iff]
  rw [buildTrie, Std.HashSet.contains_insert]
  simp only [Bool.or_eq_true, beq_iff_eq, contains_foldl_insTrie, isPrefB,
    List.isEmpty_iff, List.any_eq_true]
  constructor
  · rintro (rfl | ⟨p, hp, hw⟩ | hcon)
    · exact Or.inl rfl
    · exact Or.inr ⟨p, hp, List.isPrefixOf_iff_prefix.mpr hw⟩
    · simp at hcon
  · rintro (rfl | ⟨p, hp, hw⟩)
    · exact Or.inl rfl
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨p, hp, List.isPrefixOf_iff_prefix.mp hw⟩)

lemma mem_foldl_push {V : Type} (l : List (W × V)) (m : Std.HashMap W (List V))
    (v : W) (c : V) :
    c ∈ (l.foldl (fun m q => m.insert q.1 (q.2 :: m.getD q.1 [])) m).getD v [] ↔
      ((v, c) ∈ l ∨ c ∈ m.getD v []) := by
  induction l generalizing m with
  | nil => simp
  | cons q l ih =>
    simp only [List.foldl_cons, ih, Std.HashMap.getD_insert, List.mem_cons, Prod.ext_iff]
    by_cases h : q.1 = v
    · subst h
      have hif : (if (q.1 == q.1) = true then q.2 :: m.getD q.1 [] else m.getD q.1 [])
          = q.2 :: m.getD q.1 [] := by simp
      rw [hif]
      simp only [List.mem_cons]
      tauto
    · have hif : (if (q.1 == v) = true then q.2 :: m.getD q.1 [] else m.getD v [])
          = m.getD v [] := by simp [h]
      rw [hif]
      have h' : ¬ (v = q.1) := fun hh => h hh.symm
      tauto

lemma append_singleton_prefix_iff (p v : W) (c : UInt8) :
    v ++ [c] <+: p ↔ ∃ k, k < p.length ∧ v = p.take k ∧ c = p.getD k 0 := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hlen : (v ++ [c]).length ≤ p.length := h.length_le
    simp only [List.length_append, List.length_cons, List.length_nil] at hlen
    have hk : v.length < p.length := by omega
    have h3 : v = p.take v.length := (List.prefix_iff_eq_take).mp
      ((List.prefix_append v [c]).trans h)
    refine ⟨v.length, hk, h3, ?_⟩
    have h1 : v ++ [c] = p.take (v.length + 1) := by
      have := (List.prefix_iff_eq_take).mp h
      simpa using this
    have h2 : p.take (v.length + 1) = p.take v.length ++ [p[v.length]] := by
      rw [List.take_succ, List.getElem?_eq_getElem hk]; rfl
    rw [h2, ← h3] at h1
    have hc : [c] = [p[v.length]] := List.append_cancel_left h1
    rw [List.getD_eq_getElem p 0 hk]
    simpa using hc
  · rintro ⟨k, hk, rfl, rfl⟩
    rw [List.getD_eq_getElem p 0 hk]
    have h2 : p.take (k + 1) = p.take k ++ [p[k]] := by
      rw [List.take_succ, List.getElem?_eq_getElem hk]; rfl
    rw [← h2]
    exact List.take_prefix _ _

lemma mem_insKids (m : Std.HashMap W (List UInt8)) (p v : W) (c : UInt8) :
    c ∈ (insKids m p).getD v [] ↔ (v ++ [c] <+: p ∨ c ∈ m.getD v []) := by
  rw [insKids, mem_foldl_push, append_singleton_prefix_iff]
  simp only [List.mem_map, List.mem_range, Prod.ext_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro (⟨k, hk, h1, h2⟩ | h)
    · exact Or.inl ⟨k, hk, h1.symm, h2.symm⟩
    · exact Or.inr h
  · rintro (⟨k, hk, h1, h2⟩ | h)
    · exact Or.inl ⟨k, hk, h1.symm, h2.symm⟩
    · exact Or.inr h

lemma mem_buildKids (ps : List W) (v : W) (c : UInt8) :
    c ∈ (buildKids ps).getD v [] ↔ ∃ p ∈ ps, v ++ [c] <+: p := by
  rw [buildKids]
  have key : ∀ (l : List W) (m : Std.HashMap W (List UInt8)),
      c ∈ (l.foldl insKids m).getD v [] ↔ ((∃ p ∈ l, v ++ [c] <+: p) ∨ c ∈ m.getD v []) := by
    intro l
    induction l with
    | nil => simp
    | cons p l ih =>
      intro m
      simp only [List.foldl_cons, ih, mem_insKids, List.mem_cons]
      constructor
      · rintro (⟨q, hq, hw⟩ | hw | hw)
        · exact Or.inl ⟨q, Or.inr hq, hw⟩
        · exact Or.inl ⟨p, Or.inl rfl, hw⟩
        · exact Or.inr hw
      · rintro (⟨q, (rfl | hq), hw⟩ | hw)
        · exact Or.inr (Or.inl hw)
        · exact Or.inl ⟨q, hq, hw⟩
        · exact Or.inr (Or.inr hw)
  rw [key]
  simp

lemma mem_buildKids_iff (ps : List W) (v : W) (c : UInt8) :
    c ∈ (buildKids ps).getD v [] ↔ isPrefB ps (v ++ [c]) = true := by
  rw [mem_buildKids, isPrefB_append_iff]

lemma mem_buildOuts (ps : List W) (w : W) (pid : Nat) :
    pid ∈ (buildOuts ps).getD w [] ↔ ps[pid]? = some w := by
  rw [buildOuts, mem_foldl_push]
  simp [List.mem_zipIdx_iff_getElem?]

/-! ## Section C : correctness of the automaton transition and the BFS -/

/-- `m` stores correct failure links for all trie nodes of length at most `k`. -/
def GoodUpto (ps : List W) (m : Std.HashMap W W) (k : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ y : W, isPrefB ps y = true → y.length ≤ k → m.getD y [] = lspf (isPrefB ps) y.tail

lemma stepGo_correct (ps : List W) (m : Std.HashMap W W) :
    ∀ (fuel : Nat) (s : W) (c : UInt8), s.length < fuel → isPrefB ps s = true →
      (∀ y : W, isPrefB ps y = true → y.length ≤ s.length →
        m.getD y [] = lspf (isPrefB ps) y.tail) →
      stepGo (buildTrie ps) m fuel s c = lspf (isPrefB ps) (s ++ [c]) := by
  intro fuel
  induction fuel with
  | zero => intro s c h; exact absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | succ fuel ih =>
    intro s c hlen hs hgood
    match s with
    | [] =>
      rw [stepGo]
      by_cases hc : isPrefB ps [c] = true
      · rw [if_pos (by rw [contains_buildTrie]; exact hc)]
        rw [List.nil_append, lspf_cons_pos (isPrefB ps) c [] hc]
      · rw [if_neg (by rw [contains_buildTrie]; exact hc)]
        rw [List.nil_append, lspf_cons_neg (isPrefB ps) c [] hc, lspf_nil]
    | a :: t =>
      have hcons : (a :: t) ++ [c] = a :: (t ++ [c]) := by simp
      rw [stepGo]
      by_cases hc : isPrefB ps (a :: (t ++ [c])) = true
      · rw [if_pos (by rw [contains_buildTrie]; exact hc)]
        rw [hcons, lspf_cons_pos (isPrefB ps) a (t ++ [c]) hc]
      · rw [if_neg (by rw [contains_buildTrie]; exact hc)]
        have ht : isPrefB ps (a :: t) = true := hs
        have hm : m.getD (a :: t) [] = lspf (isPrefB ps) t := by
          have := hgood (a :: t) ht le_rfl
          simpa using this
        rw [hm]
        have hlen' : (lspf (isPrefB ps) t).length < fuel := by
          have h1 := lspf_length_le (isPrefB ps) t
          simp only [List.length_cons] at hlen
          omega
        have hs' : isPrefB ps (lspf (isPrefB ps) t) = true :=
          lspf_spec _ (isPrefB_nil ps) t
        have hgood' : ∀ y : W, isPrefB ps y = true →
            y.length ≤ (lspf (isPrefB ps) t).length →
            m.getD y [] = lspf (isPrefB ps) y.tail := by
          intro y hy hyl
          refine hgood y hy ?_
          have h1 := lspf_length_le (isPrefB ps) t
          simp only [List.length_cons]
          omega
        rw [ih (lspf (isPrefB ps) t) c hlen' hs' hgood']
        rw [hcons, lspf_cons_neg (isPrefB ps) a (t ++ [c]) hc]
        exact (lspf_append_step (isPrefB ps) (fun u w h hw => isPrefB_mono ps h hw) t c).symm

lemma failOf_correct (ps : List W) (m : Std.HashMap W W) (k : Nat) (v : W) (c : UInt8)
    (hv : isPrefB ps (v ++ [c]) = true) (hlen : v.length = k) (hgood : GoodUpto ps m k) :
    failOf (buildTrie ps) m v c = lspf (isPrefB ps) (v ++ [c]).tail := by
  match v with
  | [] => simp [failOf, lspf]
  | a :: t =>
    have hvv : isPrefB ps (a :: t) = true :=
      isPrefB_mono ps (List.prefix_append (a :: t) [c]) hv
    have hm : m.getD (a :: t) [] = lspf (isPrefB ps) t := by
      have := hgood (a :: t) hvv (le_of_eq hlen)
      simpa using this
    rw [failOf, hm]
    have hlen' : (lspf (isPrefB ps) t).length < (a :: t).length + 1 := by
      have h1 := lspf_length_le (isPrefB ps) t
      simp only [List.length_cons]
      omega
    have hs' : isPrefB ps (lspf (isPrefB ps) t) = true := lspf_spec _ (isPrefB_nil ps) t
    have hgood' : ∀ y : W, isPrefB ps y = true →
        y.length ≤ (lspf (isPrefB ps) t).length →
        m.getD y [] = lspf (isPrefB ps) y.tail := by
      intro y hy hyl
      refine hgood y hy ?_
      have h1 := lspf_length_le (isPrefB ps) t
      simp only [List.length_cons] at hlen
      omega
    rw [stepGo_correct ps m ((a :: t).length + 1) (lspf (isPrefB ps) t) c hlen' hs' hgood']
    have : ((a :: t) ++ [c]).tail = t ++ [c] := by simp
    rw [this]
    exact (lspf_append_step (isPrefB ps) (fun u w h hw => isPrefB_mono ps h hw) t c).symm

lemma bfsFold_correct (ps : List W) (k : Nat) :
    ∀ (pairs : List (W × UInt8)) (m : Std.HashMap W W),
      (∀ q ∈ pairs, isPrefB ps (q.1 ++ [q.2]) = true ∧ q.1.length = k) →
      GoodUpto ps m k →
      GoodUpto ps (bfsFold (buildTrie ps) m pairs) k ∧
      (∀ y : W, y.length = k + 1 →
        (m.getD y [] = lspf (isPrefB ps) y.tail ∨ ∃ q ∈ pairs, q.1 ++ [q.2] = y) →
        (bfsFold (buildTrie ps) m pairs).getD y [] = lspf (isPrefB ps) y.tail) := by
  intro pairs
  induction pairs with
  | nil =>
    intro m _ hgood
    refine ⟨hgood, ?_⟩
    intro y _ h
    rcases h with h | ⟨q, hq, _⟩
    · simpa [bfsFold] using h
    · simp at hq
  | cons q pairs ih =>
    intro m hpairs hgood
    have hq := hpairs q (by simp)
    have hval : failOf (buildTrie ps) m q.1 q.2 = lspf (isPrefB ps) (q.1 ++ [q.2]).tail :=
      failOf_correct ps m k q.1 q.2 hq.1 hq.2 hgood
    set m1 := m.insert (q.1 ++ [q.2]) (failOf (buildTrie ps) m q.1 q.2) with hm1
    have hkeylen : (q.1 ++ [q.2]).length = k + 1 := by
      simp only [List.length_append, List.length_cons, List.length_nil]
      omega
    have hgood1 : GoodUpto ps m1 k := by
      intro y hy hyl
      have hne : ¬ (q.1 ++ [q.2] = y) := by
        intro hcon
        rw [hcon] at hkeylen
        omega
      rw [hm1, Std.HashMap.getD_insert, if_neg (by simpa using hne)]
      exact hgood y hy hyl
    have hm1y : ∀ y : W, y.length = k + 1 →
        (m.getD y [] = lspf (isPrefB ps) y.tail ∨ q.1 ++ [q.2] = y) →
        m1.getD y [] = lspf (isPrefB ps) y.tail := by
      intro y _ h
      by_cases hy : q.1 ++ [q.2] = y
      · rw [hm1, Std.HashMap.getD_insert, if_pos (by simpa using hy), hval, hy]
      · rw [hm1, Std.HashMap.getD_insert, if_neg (by simpa using hy)]
        rcases h with h | h
        · exact h
        · exact absurd h hy
    have hrest : ∀ q' ∈ pairs, isPrefB ps (q'.1 ++ [q'.2]) = true ∧ q'.1.length = k :=
      fun q' hq' => hpairs q' (by simp [hq'])
    have hih := ih m1 hrest hgood1
    have hfold : bfsFold (buildTrie ps) m (q :: pairs) = bfsFold (buildTrie ps) m1 pairs := by
      rw [bfsFold, bfsFold, List.foldl_cons]
    rw [hfold]
    refine ⟨hih.1, ?_⟩
    intro y hy h
    refine hih.2 y hy ?_
    rcases h with h | ⟨q', hq', hq'y⟩
    · exact Or.inl (hm1y y hy (Or.inl h))
    · rcases List.mem_cons.mp hq' with rfl | hq'2
      · exact Or.inl (hm1y y hy (Or.inr hq'y))
      · exact Or.inr ⟨q', hq'2, hq'y⟩

lemma mem_bfsPairs (kids : Std.HashMap W (List UInt8)) (level : List W) (q : W × UInt8) :
    q ∈ bfsPairs kids level ↔ (q.1 ∈ level ∧ q.2 ∈ kids.getD q.1 []) := by
  simp only [bfsPairs, List.mem_flatMap, List.mem_map]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨v, hv, c, hc, hq⟩
    rw [← hq]
    exact ⟨hv, hc⟩
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
    exact ⟨q.1, h1, q.2, h2, rfl⟩

lemma bfsGo_correct (ps : List W) :
    ∀ (fuel : Nat) (m : Std.HashMap W W) (level : List W) (k : Nat),
      GoodUpto ps m k →
      (∀ x : W, x ∈ level ↔ (isPrefB ps x = true ∧ x.length = k)) →
      GoodUpto ps (bfsGo (buildTrie ps) (buildKids ps) fuel m level) (k + fuel) := by
  intro fuel
  induction fuel with
  | zero =>
    intro m level k hgood _
    rw [bfsGo]
    intro y hy hyl
    exact hgood y hy (by omega)
  | succ fuel ih =>
    intro m level k hgood hlevel
    match level with
    | [] =>
      rw [bfsGo]
      intro y hy hyl
      by_cases hk : y.length ≤ k
      · exact hgood y hy hk
      · exfalso
        have hpre : (y.take k) ∈ ([] : List W) := by
          rw [hlevel]
          refine ⟨isPrefB_mono ps (List.take_prefix k y) hy, ?_⟩
          simp only [List.length_take]
          omega
        simp at hpre
    | v :: level' =>
      rw [bfsGo]
      set pairs := bfsPairs (buildKids ps) (v :: level') with hpairs
      set m1 := bfsFold (buildTrie ps) m pairs with hm1
      have hqok : ∀ q ∈ pairs, isPrefB ps (q.1 ++ [q.2]) = true ∧ q.1.length = k := by
        intro q hq
        rw [hpairs, mem_bfsPairs] at hq
        refine ⟨?_, ((hlevel q.1).mp hq.1).2⟩
        exact (mem_buildKids_iff ps q.1 q.2).mp hq.2
      have hfold := bfsFold_correct ps k pairs m hqok hgood
      have hnext : ∀ x : W, x ∈ pairs.map (fun q => q.1 ++ [q.2]) ↔
          (isPrefB ps x = true ∧ x.length = k + 1) := by
        intro x
        simp only [List.mem_map]
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩
          have := hqok q hq
          refine ⟨this.1, ?_⟩
          simp only [List.length_append, List.length_cons, List.length_nil]
          omega
        · rintro ⟨hx, hxl⟩
          have hxne : x ≠ [] := by
            intro hcon
            rw [hcon] at hxl
            simp at hxl
          refine ⟨(x.dropLast, x.getLast hxne), ?_, ?_⟩
          · rw [hpairs, mem_bfsPairs]
            constructor
            · rw [hlevel]
              refine ⟨isPrefB_mono ps (List.dropLast_prefix x) hx, ?_⟩
              rw [List.length_dropLast]
              omega
            · rw [mem_buildKids_iff]
              simpa [List.dropLast_append_getLast hxne] using hx
          · simpa using List.dropLast_append_getLast hxne
      have hgood1 : GoodUpto ps m1 (k + 1) := by
        intro y hy hyl
        by_cases hk : y.length ≤ k
        · exact hfold.1 y hy hk
        · have hylen : y.length = k + 1 := by omega
          refine hfold.2 y hylen (Or.inr ?_)
          have := (hnext y).mpr ⟨hy, hylen⟩
          simp only [List.mem_map] at this
          obtain ⟨q, hq, hqy⟩ := this
          exact ⟨q, hq, hqy⟩
      have := ih m1 (pairs.map (fun q => q.1 ++ [q.2])) (k + 1) hgood1 hnext
      intro y hy hyl
      exact this y hy (by omega)

lemma buildFail_correct (ps : List W) (y : W) (hy : isPrefB ps y = true) :
    (buildFail (buildTrie ps) (buildKids ps) ((ps.map List.length).sum + 1)).getD y []
      = lspf (isPrefB ps) y.tail := by
  have hroot : GoodUpto ps ((∅ : Std.HashMap W W).insert [] []) 0 := by
    intro z _ hzl
    have hz : z = [] := List.eq_nil_of_length_eq_zero (by omega)
    subst hz
    simp [lspf]
  have hlevel : ∀ x : W, x ∈ ([[]] : List W) ↔ (isPrefB ps x = true ∧ x.length = 0) := by
    intro x
    simp only [List.mem_singleton]
    constructor
    · rintro rfl; exact ⟨isPrefB_nil ps, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨-, hx⟩; exact List.eq_nil_of_length_eq_zero hx
  have hbound : y.length ≤ 0 + ((ps.map List.length).sum + 1) := by
    rcases isPrefB_le_length ps hy with h | ⟨p, hp, hpl⟩
    · rw [h]; simp
    · have : p.length ≤ (ps.map List.length).sum :=
        List.single_le_sum (by intro x _; exact Nat.zero_le x) _ (List.mem_map_of_mem hp)
      omega
  exact bfsGo_correct ps ((ps.map List.length).sum + 1)
    ((∅ : Std.HashMap W W).insert [] []) [[]] 0 hroot hlevel y hy hbound

/-! ## Section D : correctness of the scan -/

lemma chainFuel_correct (ps : List W) (fm : Std.HashMap W W)
    (hfail : ∀ y : W, isPrefB ps y = true → fm.getD y [] = lspf (isPrefB ps) y.tail) :
    ∀ (fuel : Nat) (s : W), s.length < fuel → isPrefB ps s = true →
      chainFuel fm fuel s = chainSpec (isPrefB ps) s := by
  intro fuel
  induction fuel with
  | zero => intro s h; exact absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | succ fuel ih =>
    intro s hlen hs
    match s with
    | [] => rw [chainFuel, chainSpec]
    | a :: t =>
      rw [chainFuel, hfail (a :: t) hs]
      simp only [List.tail_cons]
      have h1 : (lspf (isPrefB ps) t).length < fuel := by
        have := lspf_length_le (isPrefB ps) t
        simp only [List.length_cons] at hlen
        omega
      rw [ih (lspf (isPrefB ps) t) h1 (lspf_spec _ (isPrefB_nil ps) t)]
      rw [chainSpec]

lemma mem_reportAt (m : Std.HashMap W W) (outs : Std.HashMap W (List Nat)) (s : W)
    (e pid idx : Nat) :
    (pid, idx) ∈ reportAt m outs s e ↔
      ∃ u ∈ chainFuel m (s.length + 1) s, pid ∈ outs.getD u [] ∧ idx = e - u.length := by
  simp only [reportAt, List.mem_flatMap, List.mem_map, Prod.mk.injEq]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨u, hu, pid', hpid', h1, h2⟩
    exact ⟨u, hu, h1 ▸ hpid', h2.symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨u, hu, hpid, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨u, hu, pid, hpid, rfl, rfl⟩

lemma mem_report_iff (ps : List W) (fm : Std.HashMap W W)
    (hfail : ∀ y : W, isPrefB ps y = true → fm.getD y [] = lspf (isPrefB ps) y.tail)
    (pre : List UInt8) (pid idx : Nat) :
    (pid, idx) ∈ reportAt fm (buildOuts ps) (lspf (isPrefB ps) pre) pre.length ↔
      ∃ u : W, ps[pid]? = some u ∧ u <:+ pre ∧ idx = pre.length - u.length := by
  set s := lspf (isPrefB ps) pre with hs
  have hsp : isPrefB ps s = true := lspf_spec _ (isPrefB_nil ps) pre
  rw [mem_reportAt, chainFuel_correct ps fm hfail (s.length + 1) s (by omega) hsp]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨u, hu, hpid, hidx⟩
    rw [mem_chainSpec (isPrefB ps) (isPrefB_nil ps) s hsp u] at hu
    exact ⟨u, (mem_buildOuts ps u pid).mp hpid, hu.1.trans (hs ▸ lspf_suffix (isPrefB ps) pre),
      hidx⟩
  · rintro ⟨u, hpid, hsuf, hidx⟩
    have hu : isPrefB ps u = true := by
      refine isPrefB_of_mem ps ?_
      exact List.mem_of_getElem? hpid
    refine ⟨u, ?_, (mem_buildOuts ps u pid).mpr hpid, hidx⟩
    rw [mem_chainSpec (isPrefB ps) (isPrefB_nil ps) s hsp u]
    exact ⟨hs ▸ suffix_lspf (isPrefB ps) hu pre hsuf, hu⟩

lemma mem_scan (ps : List W) (fm : Std.HashMap W W)
    (hfail : ∀ y : W, isPrefB ps y = true → fm.getD y [] = lspf (isPrefB ps) y.tail) :
    ∀ (post pre : List UInt8) (pid idx : Nat),
      ((pid, idx) ∈ scan (buildTrie ps) fm (buildOuts ps)
          (lspf (isPrefB ps) pre) post pre.length ↔
        ∃ (u : W) (j : Nat), ps[pid]? = some u ∧ pre.length ≤ j ∧
          j ≤ pre.length + post.length ∧ u <:+ (pre ++ post).take j ∧
          idx = j - u.length) := by
  intro post
  induction post with
  | nil =>
    intro pre pid idx
    rw [scan, mem_report_iff ps fm hfail pre pid idx]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨u, hpid, hsuf, hidx⟩
      refine ⟨u, pre.length, hpid, le_rfl, by simp, ?_, hidx⟩
      simpa using hsuf
    · rintro ⟨u, j, hpid, hj1, hj2, hsuf, hidx⟩
      have hje : j = pre.length := by simp at hj2; omega
      subst hje
      refine ⟨u, hpid, ?_, hidx⟩
      simpa using hsuf
  | cons c cs ih =>
    intro pre pid idx
    rw [scan]
    have hstep : stepGo (buildTrie ps) fm ((lspf (isPrefB ps) pre).length + 1)
        (lspf (isPrefB ps) pre) c = lspf (isPrefB ps) (pre ++ [c]) := by
      rw [stepGo_correct ps fm _ _ c (by omega) (lspf_spec _ (isPrefB_nil ps) pre)
        (fun y hy _ => hfail y hy)]
      exact (lspf_append_step (isPrefB ps) (fun u w h hw => isPrefB_mono ps h hw) pre c).symm
    have hlen : pre.length + 1 = (pre ++ [c]).length := by simp
    rw [hstep, hlen]
    rw [List.mem_append, ih (pre ++ [c]) pid idx, mem_report_iff ps fm hfail pre pid idx]
    have hassoc : (pre ++ [c]) ++ cs = pre ++ (c :: cs) := by simp
    rw [hassoc]
    constructor
    · rintro (⟨u, hpid, hsuf, hidx⟩ | ⟨u, j, hpid, hj1, hj2, hsuf, hidx⟩)
      · refine ⟨u, pre.length, hpid, le_rfl, by simp, ?_, hidx⟩
        rw [show (pre ++ c :: cs).take pre.length = pre by simp]
        exact hsuf
      · exact ⟨u, j, hpid, by simp at hj1; omega, by simp at hj2 ⊢; omega, hsuf, hidx⟩
    · rintro ⟨u, j, hpid, hj1, hj2, hsuf, hidx⟩
      by_cases hje : j = pre.length
      · subst hje
        refine Or.inl ⟨u, hpid, ?_, hidx⟩
        rw [show (pre ++ c :: cs).take pre.length = pre from by simp] at hsuf
        exact hsuf
      · refine Or.inr ⟨u, j, hpid, by simp; omega, by simp at hj2 ⊢; omega, hsuf, hidx⟩

lemma mem_acSearchOn (ps : List W) (text : List UInt8) (pid idx : Nat) :
    (pid, idx) ∈ acSearchOn ps text ↔
      ∃ u : W, ps[pid]? = some u ∧ idx + u.length ≤ text.length ∧
        u <:+ text.take (idx + u.length) := by
  have hfail := buildFail_correct ps
  rw [acSearchOn]
  have h0 : lspf (isPrefB ps) [] = [] := lspf_nil _
  have := mem_scan ps
    (buildFail (buildTrie ps) (buildKids ps) ((ps.map List.length).sum + 1)) hfail
    text [] pid idx
  rw [h0] at this
  simp only [List.length_nil, List.nil_append, Nat.zero_le, true_and, Nat.zero_add] at this
  rw [this]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨u, j, hpid, hj, hsuf, hidx⟩
    have hul : u.length ≤ j := by
      have := hsuf.length_le
      simp only [List.length_take] at this
      omega
    have hj' : j = idx + u.length := by omega
    subst hj'
    exact ⟨u, hpid, by omega, hsuf⟩
  · rintro ⟨u, hpid, hle, hsuf⟩
    exact ⟨u, idx + u.length, hpid, hle, hsuf, by omega⟩

def ac_automata_search (haystack : Array UInt8) (patterns : Array (Array UInt8))
    (_ : ac_automata_search_precond haystack patterns) :
    Array (Nat × Nat) :=
  -- !benchmark @start code

-- Postcondition auxiliary definitions
def matches_at (haystack : Array UInt8) (needle : Array UInt8) (start : Nat) : Prop :=
  start + needle.size ≤ haystack.size ∧
  (∀ i : Nat, i < needle.size → haystack.getD (start + i) 0 = needle.getD i 0)

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def ac_automata_search_postcond (haystack : Array UInt8) (patterns : Array (Array UInt8))
    (result : Array (Nat × Nat)) (_ : ac_automata_search_precond haystack patterns) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  (∀ i : Nat, i < result.size →
      let pair := result.getD i (0, 0)
      let pid := pair.fst
      let idx := pair.snd
      pid < patterns.size ∧
      -- Removed duplicate `pid < patterns.size` check
      matches_at haystack (patterns.getD pid #[]) idx) ∧
  (∀ pid idx : Nat,
      pid < patterns.size →
      matches_at haystack (patterns.getD pid #[]) idx →
      ∃ k : Nat, k < result.size ∧ result.getD k (0, 0) = (pid, idx))
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

lemma array_getD_of_lt {α : Type} (a : Array α) (i : Nat) (d : α) (h : i < a.size) :
    a.getD i d = a[i] := by
  rw [Array.getD]
  exact dif_pos h

/-- A match of `needle` at `start` is exactly a suffix condition on a prefix of the text. -/
lemma matches_at_iff (haystack needle : Array UInt8) (start : Nat) :
    matches_at haystack needle start ↔
      (start + needle.toList.length ≤ haystack.toList.length ∧
        needle.toList <:+ haystack.toList.take (start + needle.toList.length)) := by
  set A := haystack.toList with hA
  set B := needle.toList with hB
  have hAlen : A.length = haystack.size := by simp [hA]
  have hBlen : B.length = needle.size := by simp [hB]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
    refine ⟨by omega, ?_⟩
    rw [List.suffix_iff_eq_drop]
    have hlen : (A.take (start + B.length)).length = start + B.length := by
      simp only [List.length_take]
      omega
    rw [hlen, Nat.add_sub_cancel]
    apply List.ext_getElem
    · simp only [List.length_drop, hlen]
      omega
    · intro i hi1 hi2
      have hiB : i < B.length := by
        simpa [hlen] using hi2
      have hstart : start + i < A.length := by omega
      have := h2 i (by omega)
      rw [array_getD_of_lt haystack (start + i) 0 (by omega),
        array_getD_of_lt needle i 0 (by omega)] at this
      rw [List.getElem_drop, List.getElem_take]
      simpa [hA, hB] using this.symm
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
    refine ⟨by omega, ?_⟩
    intro i hi
    have hiB : i < B.length := by omega
    rw [List.suffix_iff_eq_drop] at h2
    have hlen : (A.take (start + B.length)).length = start + B.length := by
      simp only [List.length_take]
      omega
    rw [hlen, Nat.add_sub_cancel] at h2
    have := congrArg (fun l => l.getD i 0) h2
    simp only at this
    rw [array_getD_of_lt haystack (start + i) 0 (by omega),
      array_getD_of_lt needle i 0 (by omega)]
    have hd : ((A.take (start + B.length)).drop start).getD i 0 = A.getD (start + i) 0 := by
      rw [List.getD_eq_getElem _ _ (by simp only [List.length_drop, hlen]; omega),
        List.getD_eq_getElem _ _ (by omega)]
      rw [List.getElem_drop, List.getElem_take]
    rw [hd] at this
    rw [List.getD_eq_getElem A 0 (by omega)] at this
    rw [List.getD_eq_getElem B 0 (by omega)] at this
    simpa [hA, hB] using this.symm

theorem acSearch_mem (haystack : Array UInt8) (patterns : Array (Array UInt8))
    (pid idx : Nat) :
    (pid, idx) ∈ acSearch haystack patterns ↔
      (pid < patterns.size ∧ matches_at haystack (patterns.getD pid #[]) idx) := by
  rw [acSearch]
  rw [List.mem_toArray]
  rw [mem_acSearchOn]
  set ps : List ACA.W := patterns.toList.map Array.toList with hps
  have hpslen : ps.length = patterns.size := by simp [hps]
  by_cases hpid : pid < patterns.size
  · have hget : ps[pid]? = some (patterns[pid].toList) := by
      rw [hps]
      rw [List.getElem?_map]
      rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem (by simpa using hpid)]
      simp
    have hpat : patterns.getD pid #[] = patterns[pid] := array_getD_of_lt _ _ _ hpid
    rw [hpat, matches_at_iff]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨u, hu, hle, hsuf⟩
      rw [hget] at hu
      cases hu
      exact ⟨hpid, hle, hsuf⟩
    · rintro ⟨-, hle, hsuf⟩
      exact ⟨patterns[pid].toList, hget, hle, hsuf⟩
  · constructor
    · rintro ⟨u, hu, -, -⟩
      exfalso

## Done — `LEAN VERIFIED`

`Solution.lean` implements Aho–Corasick and proves the full postcondition (soundness **and** completeness), with all four markers intact and no `sorry`/axioms/`partial`/oracles in the editable sections.

**Implementation** (all in `auxcode`, called from `code`):
- **Trie**: `buildTrie` — a `Std.HashSet` of all pattern prefixes; `buildKids` — the trie edges; `buildOuts` — pattern ids per node (a *list*, so duplicate patterns are all reported).
- **Failure links by BFS**: `bfsGo` walks the trie level by level, generating level `k+1` from level `k` through the children map, and sets `fail (v ++ [c]) = goto(fail v, c)` (root children get the root). Every lookup it makes is for a strictly shorter word — that is the BFS-order argument, and it is what the proof formalizes.
- **Traversal**: `scan` runs the text once, `state := goto(state, c)`, and at every position (including position 0, before any character) walks the failure chain emitting `(pid, e - |u|)`.
- States are identified with their canonical word label instead of an integer node id — same automaton, no id↔word bijection to carry through every proof.

**Proof spine**: the central lemma is `lspf (x ++ [c]) = lspf (lspf x ++ [c])` (`lspf x` = longest suffix of `x` that is a trie node). It yields both the failure-link recurrence and the scan invariant `state = lspf (text.take e)`. Combined with `u ∈ failChain s ↔ u <:+ s ∧ u is a node`, the emitted pairs at each position are exactly the patterns that are suffixes of the consumed text; `matches_at_iff` bridges that to the array-level `matches_at`. Details in `ProofState.md`.

**Audit notes:**
- The executable path never touches the specification functions (`isPrefB`, `lspf`, `chainSpec` appear only in lemmas), so nothing is a spec oracle.
- Edge cases are covered by the proved equivalence itself: empty patterns (reported at all `|haystack|+1` positions, since reporting happens at position 0 and after every character), duplicate patterns, empty haystack, patterns longer than the text. The `e - |u|` subtraction is safe because `u` is a suffix of `text.take e`.
- Preconditions are not needed — the result is proved unconditionally, which is strictly stronger.
- One honest deviation, now recorded in `AlgorithmPlan.md`: the *step count* is textbook Aho–Corasick, but because a state is its own word, each hash/compare costs `O(|state|)` rather than `O(1)` — construction is `O(Σ|pᵢ|²)` byte-ops and the scan `O((|text|+z)·L)`. Integer node ids would restore `O(1)` per step at the cost of threading an id↔word invariant through every construction proof; I took that trade-off deliberately rather than silently.
